resources.string:
• Accepted formats: PDF (preferred), AI, PSD, PNG, JPG
• Resolution: minimum 300 DPI at final print size
• Colour mode: CMYK for print (RGB colours may shift)
• Bleed: add 3 mm bleed on every edge
• Safe zone: keep text and logos 5 mm inside the trim line
• Fonts: outline or embed all fonts
• Black text: use 100% K, not rich black
• Maximum upload size: 25 MB
